title: BOC, NBI seize over P500-M worth of smuggled agri products in Valenzuela City
summary: The Bureau of Customs (BOC) and the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) have seized more than half a billion peso worth of agricultural products in a warehouse in Valenzuela City.
